title: 第777章 什么魅力值得你这么卖命第776章 圣女
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: 只是语气平静地说了一句。
圣女清冷的眸子中闪过一丝愠怒。
“你若是敢动我一根汗毛，我敢保证，这天地虽大，将再无你容身之地。”
“威胁我？省省吧，小丫头片子，老头子可不是被吓大的。”
圣女眼中闪过一丝寒芒。
孤鸿子哼笑一声，没有回答。
而是出手，将圣女的修为给封印。
孤鸿子没有触碰到圣女一下。
到时说不定就被楚王给看上了。
碰楚王的女人，那不是老寿星吃砒霜吗？
万千银丝化作一道白芒，瞬间将圣女缠的严严实实。
圣女被银丝禁锢，面纱下那张绝美的面容上不见丝毫惊惶，眼神愈发冰冷刺骨。
“你看老子后不后悔就完事了。”
说完，没有再和圣女废话，拂尘拽着圣女便准备跑。
此地的动静早已惊动了巫神殿的强者。
伴随着几声惊怒交加的暴喝。
十几道穿着绣有巫神图腾的黑袍人影，从四面八方赶了进来。
content_en:
The saint didn't move.
He just said something in a calm tone.
"You are so brave!"
Gu Hongzi chuckled.
"Thank you for the compliment, Lady Saint."
A hint of anger flashed in the saint's cold eyes.
"If you dare to touch a hair on my head, I can guarantee that no matter how big this world is, there will be no place for you."
"Jiejiejie..."
Gu Hongzi laughed strangely.
"Threatening me? Save it, little girl, the old man is not one to be scared."
"As for touching you?"
"I haven't thought about it."
Gu Hongzi shook his head.
"You are my qualification for success!"
"The qualifications to enter the body?"
A cold light flashed in the saint's eyes.
"Are you from Chu State?"
Gu Hongzi chuckled and did not answer.
Instead, he took action to seal the saint's cultivation.
In this process.
Gu Hongzi did not touch the saint.
This saint girl is extremely beautiful.
And the King of Chu is very beautiful.
At that time, he might be attracted by King Chu.
If you touch the King of Chu's woman, isn't it like a longevity star eating arsenic?
Gu Hongzi flicked the whisk in his hand.
Thousands of silver threads turned into a white light, instantly wrapping the saint girl tightly.
The saint was imprisoned by the silver wire, and there was no trace of panic on her beautiful face under the veil, and her eyes became colder and biting.
"You'll regret it."
Gu Hongzi sneered.
"If you don't regret it after seeing me, that's it."
After saying that, without any more nonsense with the saint, Wu Chen grabbed the saint and prepared to run away.
However.
The movement here has already alarmed the powerful men of the Witch Temple.
"Bold maniac, let go of the saint!"
"Trespassing to the Witch Temple is a capital offense!"
Accompanied by several shouts of shock and anger.
More than a dozen figures wearing black robes embroidered with the totems of the Witch God rushed in from all directions.
